category_title: Non-symbolic communicators with quadriplegic cerebral palsy who use facial expressions and physical resistance to express preferences
minimal_context: Tony is participating in a painting session with staff using paper and a tube of paint.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our painting session. Here is the paper, the brush, and the tube of paint.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: (Tries to dislodge his hand from the tube) Please let go of the paint so we can start.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: (Pushes his hand onto the paper to start painting) Let's just put your hand here and paint on the paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (His smile vanishes, his mouth opens wide until he grimaces, his head turns away from the paper, and he cries.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for our painting session. Here is the paper, the brush, and the tube of paint.

STUDENT: (Holds onto the tube of paint.)

TUTOR: (Tries to dislodge his hand from the tube) Please let go of the paint so we can start.

STUDENT: (He holds on tightly) Heh.

TUTOR: (Pushes his hand onto the paper to start painting) Let's just put your hand here and paint on the paper.

STUDENT: (His smile vanishes, his mouth opens wide until he grimaces, his head turns away from the paper, and he cries.)

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: prompted to paint on paper, in conjunction with two staff
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: his mouth opens wide until he grimaces, his head turns away from the paper, and he cries
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: upset characterized by a negative emotional component

behavior_patterns.condition: Mary to push his hand onto the paper and start painting
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: smile vanishes, his mouth opens and his face looks strained

behavior_patterns.condition: Mary is trying to dislodge Tony's hand from the tube
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: He holds on and then rather mischievously seems to celebrate his victory by vocalizing the utterance 'Heh'
behavior_patterns.internal_state: mischievously seems to celebrate his victory
